./workflow-editor.purpose: Workspace hosts the definition editor through its top-level view.

./workflow-editor-list.purpose: Workspace sidebar places the editor-owned definition list.

./workflow-editor-store.purpose: Sidebar and shell integration tests coordinate editor selection; the workspace boundary observes editor-owned render recovery. Persisted definitions remain state/data owned.

./workflow-transfer.purpose: Settings resolves the plugin dependencies of the workflows an imported package carries with the same rules the editor's import preview uses, so both import entries agree.

./workflow-transfer-dependencies.purpose: Settings renders an imported package's workflow dependencies with the same list, statuses, node usage, and install entries as the editor import preview.

./translations.purpose: The single i18n composition loads this feature's pure resource bundle.
